project: Wuxia Life P17 Mid-Late-Life Consequence And Faction-Relationship Closure
description: Close the mid- and late-life consequence gap in wuxia-life by making relationships, faction and social identity, and high-tier achievements create persistent upside, burden, risk, and maintenance pressure through profile-first configuration, minimal theme-neutral runtime support, representative content slices, and evidence-based validation without expanding into descendants, UI work, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit sustained relationship consequence surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current ally, enemy, mentor, kinship, and sworn-tie consequence surfaces so that P17 targets the highest-impact relationship closure gaps first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current sustained relationship consequence sources across allies, enemies, mentors, kinship ties, and comparable long-term bonds
Mark each relationship consequence surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where relationship consequences currently collapse into one-off labels, flavor text, or summary-only outcomes
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit faction and social identity consequence surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of faction and identity consequence surfaces so that P17 can close the biggest role-pressure gaps before implementation starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current sustained consequence sources across faction ties, sect or organization roles, social status, and comparable identity layers
Mark each faction or identity consequence surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where faction or identity outcomes currently end as static labels, prestige text, or low-impact summaries
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit high-tier achievement consequence surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of post-achievement consequence surfaces so that P17 can identify where major success still ends without ongoing pressure.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current sustained consequence sources for major achievements, titles, leadership states, and comparable high-tier outcomes
Mark each achievement consequence surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where achievements currently resolve into prestige-only or end-state outputs without ongoing maintenance pressure
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write relationship consequence loop rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for long-term relationship consequence loops so that later P17 relationship stories converge on one coherent mid-late-life model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how long-term positive and negative consequence loops should work for allies, enemies, kinship ties, mentors, and comparable relationship types
Define which relationship consequences should stay explicit in summaries or reports versus which may remain partially implicit in downstream weighting
Record what counts as meaningful aid, burden, protection, obligation, entanglement, or betrayal pressure in P17
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write faction and identity consequence rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for faction and identity consequences so that membership, status, and role pressure are modeled consistently instead of as isolated tweaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how faction or identity membership creates both benefits and obligations
Define the target balance between protection, access, duty, exposure, rivalry, and political cost
Record whether kinship-like and sworn-brotherhood-like ties share this layer or stay partially separate in the first P17 pass
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write achievement maintenance rules and P17 scope boundary
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit post-achievement maintenance rules and a clear P17 scope boundary so that later implementation stories stay focused on consequence closure instead of expanding into legacy systems.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how major achievements introduce ongoing maintenance pressure rather than static prestige only
Define which maintenance dimensions are in scope for P17 and which are deferred beyond it
Record the P17 non-goals for descendants, UI expansion, second-theme feature work, and large runtime rewrites in implementation-facing terms
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/
